items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: So between Harry Dial and Lem Johnson they'll alternate

ctx.x: Very well. They have a regular what you call team for -- to substitute anytime they do funeral [two times.] Between Kenneth Roane- he's past master (unintelligible) Dial, he's past master, he would do the funeral (table). We would do the other parts with him. And one time we had funerals back to back. Had to and do one on a Monday, me on a Tuesday. We had -- that year, in 1959, we had 11 funerals. And we had to participate in all those funerals. So between Harry Dial and Lem Johnson they'll alternate…

You know, the thing that strikes me as funny, when you come to think of it, is all that business of the New Orleans funerals, marching out and playing, the band playing back. Now, you know, they've made a sort of a gimmick of that really.
